title: Schema-init connection is never closed
evidence: app.py:90 `with sqlite3.connect(...) as conn:` — the sqlite3 context manager commits but does not close, so each create_app() call leaks one connection (notably across the many test fixtures)
suggestion: Use `conn = sqlite3.connect(...); conn.executescript(SCHEMA); conn.close()` or wrap in contextlib.closing

title: PUT performs full-replace, not partial update
evidence: app.py:174 update_book revalidates the whole payload and overwrites all columns; omitting isbn/year resets them to NULL (documented in README and test_update_book)
suggestion: Acceptable per spec (TASK.md says 'Update a book'); note only — PATCH semantics were not requested
